title: Ledger, opened in place
summary: The four services as the kit's ledger, keyed by the band's flag codes: each row opens in place to show what it replaces (struck through), what it ships and into which asset, and — on deliverability and CRM — the page's two sourced readings.
story: The legend to the route. Each flag on the band becomes a row; opening one answers the RevOps buyer's real question — what does this replace in my stack, and what do I hold afterwards — and the evidence sits where it applies instead of in a stat grid.
copy: [N] statement “Built in your stack. / Documented in your language.” (the page's second statement)
[R] the four row lines; [N] the four ‘Replaces’ lines
[R] Ships: Deliverability runbook → Orchestration Rules · ICP & Signal Map · Orchestration Rules · CRM blueprint (the record under both assets)

[K figures, R wording] readings “1 in 6 · legitimate marketing emails that never reach the inbox (global) · Validity, 2025” and “28% · of a seller’s week spent actually selling (7,775 sellers surveyed) · Salesforce, State of Sales, 2022”
Cut per §4.2: outbound engine build, inbox rotation, throttling, volume, list sourcing, Litmus, Pitchbox ×2, Gartner $12.9M, “six disconnected tools”
phone: ≤1023: the descriptor drops under the title; the open part stacks. ≤767: the two rows that carry the page's readings (02.1, 02.4) rest open and cannot close (no reading behind a toggle; JS keeps aria-expanded true); 02.2 and 02.3 keep the ledger's toggle, closed at rest. Each reading sets its figure beside its words; the long field-note link wraps at 12px.

reference.site: Approved homepage fit/U and system/T ledgers (kit .ac-ledger) and handover/U's struck-through ‘before’ lines
reference.borrowed: The kit's ledger that opens in place, and the handover's before/after strike.
reference.kelwin: Rows keyed by the band's code boxes; the open part is a spec (Replaces · Ships → asset) with the reading set beside it, so evidence lives on the service it supports.

motion: entrance: the kit statement choreography (label, two lines rise, rule); the four rows set one by one (110ms apart).
interaction: each row head is a button; it opens in place (360ms, kit), the + turns to −; 02.1 rests open. Kit hovers on the readings' sources and the field-note link.
on the live site: reveals once on scroll. Reduced motion: final state, toggles instant.
notes: ≈ 1,000px at 1440 with 02.1 open. The page's two readings live in rows 02.1 (open) and 02.4.
